maya: Heads-up: we're retiring the temporary SSO proxy shim next week (planned disable Tue 2026-05-19 10:00 UTC).

maya: Reason: it causes duplicate sessions across regions and makes OIDC for self-hosted runners flaky. We want everyone on the direct OIDC path (Okta -> GH OIDC) or Vault short-lived tokens.

chung: What's the opt-in/testing window look like?

maya: Opt-in testing available now. Suggested timeline: test on staging by Fri, staged disable Tue 10:00 UTC for non-critical orgs, full disable Thu 18:00 UTC. We'll keep a 72h compatibility header for emergency rollbacks.

chung: Does this break GitHub web SSO?

maya: No for normal web SSO if you use org SAML/OIDC. Breaks occur for PAT-backed CI runners and old deploy bots. Those must move to OIDC or Vault short-lived creds.

devex-bot: DevEx action: updating GH Actions templates and adding OIDC examples to infra-templates repo. PR expected today.

chung: Can we get a small GH Actions example?

maya: Sure — gist of it: set permissions id-token: write, request the ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN, then exchange at our IdP. We'll put the exact snippet in the wiki.

ops-bot: Ops note: scanning /etc/deploy/*.key for long-lived keys Wed 03:00 UTC. Tickets auto-created for any matches.

security-bot: Reminder: teams going into strict session-hardening must register redirect_uris and allowed_audiences in IdP. Non-registered audiences will get 401s after cutover.

chung: If we hit failures after compatibility header, what's the fallback?

maya: We can re-enable the shim per-org but require an approval and a 2-week tech-debt ticket. We'll reserve that for emergencies only.

chung: Any dashboards to watch during cutover?

maya: Yes: Console -> Auth -> Session Health and CI token errors dashboard. Links + runbook in the wiki checklist.

maya: Action items for teams: 1) Test OIDC flow on staging by EOD Fri, 2) Replace PAT-backed runner creds, 3) Confirm completion on the checklist doc.

chung: Thanks — we'll test and report back here.

maya: I'll run a short patch-call Tue 09:30 UTC to triage live issues. If you need a different window, open a ticket in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
